actual_original_statements.text: Aqua effortlessly outperforms a professional entertainer for free. The performer concludes he has no future, gives her his juggling props, and leaves to farm. Aqua interprets the result as personal good fortune.
> attention/play reward + genuine high skill → performance without stakeholder model → another person's livelihood collapses → Aqua notices the gift more readily than the social cost.
**Externality blindness.** Wiz's inventory losses and the street performer's ruined career continue the pattern of weak downstream stakeholder modeling.

current_qualified_claims.plane: Aqua own account of gift and relayed intention
current_qualified_claims.claim: Aqua says the performer gave props and intended to return to the family farm. Her quoted phrase from him is mediated through her speech; completed departure or succession is not narrated.
Aqua actually holds and uses the juggling rings. Their physical presence is directly available; the earlier handover remains her account.

He interprets Aqua as having broken the performer spirit and disrupted a life. This is legitimate narrative evaluation supporting an externality concern, not independent confirmation of permanent career collapse.

Retain the supported livelihood/attention externality and reported distress. Replace certainty about performed departure, completed farming and a permanently ruined career with the narrower reported reaction/intention and narrator inference. These distinctions qualify the original shorthand; they do not prove the reports false or excuse the cost.

counterevidence_and_uncertainty: Visible props and two differently placed character reports give substantive evidence of a harmful local episode; no claim that nothing happened.
No subsequent rural-work scene or lifetime outcome appears in the checked passage. Absence of that scene neither proves departure impossible nor proves completed departure.

MAIN16U023Pierre self-names and claims capital status without a personal continuity reference. Retain separate episode identities; neither a shared occupation nor lack of a name proves alias or distinct-person certainty.
Aqua good-fortune account does not independently distinguish inability to understand the cost from local inattention or indifference. Broader Aqua care/capacity counterexamples remain.
